name: LangGraph
summary: Orchestrate stateful agent workflows as graphs with explicit state and control flow.
tradeoffs: Explicit state and orchestration add design complexity; use a simpler workflow when it is enough.

origin.basis: Official LangChain organization profile; canonical repository maintained in the LangChain organization.

name: CrewAI
summary: Build agent workflows around task-oriented roles and collaboration.
tradeoffs: Multiple agents can add latency, cost, and failure modes; compare against a single-agent baseline.

origin.basis: Official CrewAI organization profile and company site identify the project and steward.

name: AutoGen
summary: Framework for building applications that coordinate agents, tools, and conversations.
tradeoffs: APIs and project direction can evolve; check current version guidance before starting a new implementation.

origin.basis: Canonical repository maintained in Microsoft official GitHub organization.

name: Semantic Kernel
summary: Add AI orchestration, plugins, and memory patterns to application code.
best_for: integrating AI features into existing services
tradeoffs: Provider and abstraction choices should be kept explicit to avoid accidental lock-in.

origin.basis: Canonical repository maintained in Microsoft official GitHub organization.

name: LlamaIndex
summary: Connect data sources and retrieval components to data-connected AI applications.
tradeoffs: The integration surface is large; begin with only the connectors and abstractions your use case requires.

origin.basis: Canonical LlamaIndex repository and official project organization page identify steward.

name: Haystack
summary: Compose search, retrieval, generation, and agent components into pipelines.
tradeoffs: Flexible pipelines still require task-specific evaluation, observability, and careful component selection.

origin.basis: Official deepset organization profile identifies project steward and Germany location.

name: Qdrant
summary: Vector database and similarity-search engine for retrieval applications.
tradeoffs: Search quality depends on data preparation, embeddings, filters, and evaluation—not the database alone.

origin.basis: Official Qdrant organization profile identifies project steward and Germany location.

name: Vespa
summary: Search and serving platform for text, vector, and structured retrieval workloads.
best_for: ranking and serving with structured data
tradeoffs: It has more operational and architectural surface area than a small vector-store deployment.

origin.basis: Official Vespa project about page documents official project and corporate lineage.

name: Docling
summary: Parse and convert complex documents into structured representations for downstream applications.
best_for: layout-aware conversion before retrieval or extraction
tradeoffs: Validate parsing quality on representative file types, languages, and layouts from your own corpus.

origin.basis: Official Docling organization profile identifies the project and Switzerland location.

name: Unstructured
summary: Ingest and partition diverse file formats into structured elements for downstream workflows.
best_for: document pipelines that need a common representation
tradeoffs: Check which connectors and capabilities are open source versus hosted or commercial.

origin.basis: Official Unstructured company site identifies the project steward.

name: Apache Tika
summary: Detect file types and extract text and metadata from a broad range of formats.
best_for: content detection and baseline text/metadata extraction
tradeoffs: A parser toolkit is not a complete layout-aware document-understanding pipeline.

origin.basis: Apache Software Foundation is the official steward of the Apache Tika project.

name: MarkItDown
summary: Convert files and office documents into Markdown for downstream text workflows.
tradeoffs: Markdown conversion can lose layout or semantic relationships needed for precise extraction.

origin.basis: Canonical repository maintained in Microsoft official GitHub organization.

name: Gradio
summary: Build interactive Python interfaces and demos for machine-learning applications.
tradeoffs: Production authentication, isolation, and scaling need separate engineering decisions.

origin.basis: Official Gradio organization profile and about page identify project steward.

name: Streamlit
summary: Create interactive data and AI applications in Python with a compact development workflow.
tradeoffs: Complex multi-user products may need a more conventional web architecture.

origin.basis: Official Streamlit project site and organization profile identify current steward.

name: OpenCV
summary: Computer-vision and image/video processing primitives for application pipelines.
tradeoffs: Core primitives need application-specific logic, tests, and review of optional modules.

origin.basis: Official OpenCV about page identifies its foundation and project stewardship.

name: OpenTelemetry Collector
summary: Receive, process, and export telemetry through a vendor-neutral collector pipeline.
best_for: routing traces and metrics across backends
tradeoffs: AI-specific instrumentation, conventions, and dashboards still need to be defined.

origin.basis: Official CNCF OpenTelemetry project page documents governance and steward.

name: Kubernetes
summary: Schedule and manage containerized workloads across clusters.
tradeoffs: Can be excessive for small AI applications; include platform team and operational costs.

origin.basis: Official CNCF Kubernetes project page documents governance and steward.

name: Docker Compose
summary: Define and run multi-container applications from a Compose configuration.
best_for: small services with a few cooperating containers
tradeoffs: Useful for development and modest deployments, but not a universal production orchestrator.

origin.basis: Official Docker company page and organization profile identify project stewardship.

name: BentoML
summary: Package and serve machine-learning inference applications and APIs.
tradeoffs: Test target runtime, hardware, model compatibility, and packaging assumptions explicitly.

origin.basis: Official BentoML company page identifies the project and steward.

name: Ray
summary: Scale Python applications and machine-learning workloads across distributed compute.
best_for: workloads that exceed a single process or machine
tradeoffs: Adds operational complexity; adopt it when distributed execution is needed, not as default ceremony.

origin.basis: Official Ray project and Anyscale pages document project lineage and steward.
